title: Relative differentials of a surjection (Stacks Tag 07BP)
statement: Let $A\twoheadrightarrow B$ be a surjective homomorphism of commutative rings. For the Kähler-differential module $\Omega_{B/A}$ of [def-weil-pbc-kahler-differentials], **Stacks Tag 07BP (lemma-NL-surjection)** implies $\Omega_{B/A}=0$ (equivalently, $\Omega_{B/A}$ is subsingleton and hence the zero module).
